title: Step 3 - Evaluating Random Forest Performance: Test Set Results & Overfitting

cues.en: Instructor: And now let's see.
cues.zh: 現在來看看。

cues.en: Okay, so the random forest classifier definitely catches most of the users that didn't buy the SUV in the right category, that is the red region.
cues.zh: 隨機森林分類器的確把大多數沒有購買 SUV 的使用者，放進正確的類別，也就是紅色區域。

cues.en: So that means that it classified well most of the users who didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 代表它正確分類了大多數沒有購買 SUV 的使用者。

cues.en: And same for the green users who are the users that bought the SUV in reality, because, as we can see, most of them are in the right green region.
cues.zh: 綠色使用者也一樣，他們實際上購買了 SUV，可以看到多數都在正確的綠色區域。

cues.en: And it's desperately trying to catch some outliers, we can call them this way.
cues.zh: 它還拼命試著涵蓋一些離群值，可以這麼稱呼。

cues.en: For example, this guy here is a user that didn't buy the SUV in reality, because this is a red point, and it is way into the green region here as we can see.
cues.zh: 例如這位使用者實際沒有購買 SUV，因為是紅點，但可以看到他深入綠色區域。

cues.en: But the random forest classifier managed to make this little rectangle part of the region in red to catch this user that didn't buy the SUV
cues.zh: 隨機森林分類器成功把這塊小長方形區域改成紅色，涵蓋這位沒有購買 SUV 的使用者，

cues.en: and classify it well.
cues.zh: 將他正確分類。

cues.en: But is it the smart way of doing this?
cues.zh: 但這是明智的做法嗎？

cues.en: Because what we'll tell you that for some new observations we will have, you know, some users who didn't buy the SUV in this red rectangle here.
cues.zh: 因為有什麼能告訴你，在新觀測值中，這個紅色長方形會出現沒有購買 SUV 的使用者？

cues.en: So that looks like overfitting, because it made this red rectangle here, because we had this user indeed who didn't buy the SUV.
cues.zh: 這看起來像過度擬合，因為它建立紅色長方形，只因為確實有這位沒有購買 SUV 的使用者。

cues.en: But nothing tells us that for some new observations, we will have some users who didn't buy the SUV in this red rectangle here.
cues.zh: 但沒有任何資訊保證，新觀測值在這個紅色長方形內，也會是沒有購買 SUV 的使用者。

cues.en: So we should be careful with that.
cues.zh: 所以要小心。

cues.en: And same for this user here.
cues.zh: 這位使用者也一樣。

cues.en: As you can see that this user isn't some sort of irregular red region here, but, fortunately, our random forest classifier was not too obsessed at making all predictions correct,
cues.zh: 可以看到，這位使用者在某種不規則紅色區域中，不過幸好隨機森林分類器沒有太執著於讓所有預測正確，

cues.en: because, as we can see, this red user here is in the green region.
cues.zh: 因為可以看到，這位紅色使用者在綠色區域。

cues.en: So that means that it still paid attention to overfitting, but not too much, and we should be careful with that.
cues.zh: 代表它仍稍微注意了過度擬合，但不算太多，這要小心。

cues.en: So speaking of overfitting, let's check that right now.
cues.zh: 說到過度擬合，現在就確認。

cues.en: Let's look at the test set results right now to see how these regions here, because you know the regions won't change, these are the regions built by our model.
cues.zh: 看看測試集結果，了解這些區域，因為區域不會變，是模型建立的區域。

cues.en: So when we look at the test set results, we will have the same red region here with this rectangle here and green region here.
cues.zh: 所以測試集結果仍會有相同的紅色區域、這個長方形，以及綠色區域。

cues.en: But what will change will be the test set observation points that is all the red points and the green points.
cues.zh: 會改變的是測試集觀測點，也就是所有紅點與綠點。

cues.en: This will change and we will see if we have some red points here in this rectangle here.
cues.zh: 這些會改變，我們要看這個長方形中會不會有紅點。

cues.en: And actually probably not, because this looks like overfitting that occurred, because our classifier was fitted too much to the training set.
cues.zh: 實際上可能沒有，因為這看起來是過度擬合，分類器過度貼合訓練集。

cues.en: So let's find out about that right now.
cues.zh: 現在來確認。

cues.en: Let's select this section dedicated to visualizing the test set results.
cues.zh: 選取專門視覺化測試集結果的區段。

cues.en: So I'll just select everything and press command and control plus enter to execute.
cues.zh: 全部選取，按 Command 或 Control + Enter 執行。

cues.en: All right, so what is the first thing you see here?
cues.zh: 好，第一眼看到了什麼？

cues.en: Well, yes indeed.
cues.zh: 是的，確實如此。

cues.en: This red rectangle here is totally not useful for some new observations.
cues.zh: 這個紅色長方形對新觀測值完全沒有用。

cues.en: So that was clearly a red rectangle region to catch some users of the training set, because our classifier was too much fitted to the training set.
cues.zh: 所以這明顯是為了涵蓋訓練集部分使用者而建立的紅色長方形區域，因為分類器對訓練集擬合太多。

cues.en: And this red rectangle actually doesn't make any sense here, because, indeed, we don't have any red user in this rectangle region here.
cues.zh: 這個紅色長方形在這裡其實沒有意義，因為裡面確實沒有任何紅色使用者。

cues.en: Well, it's not that it doesn't make any sense, but it's totally not useful here.
cues.zh: 也不能說沒有意義，只是在這裡完全沒有用。

cues.en: And besides, you know, we have this green point here, and this green point could have been in this region here that would make an incorrect prediction.
cues.zh: 此外，這裡有個綠點，它本來可能落在這個區域，形成錯誤預測。

cues.en: We were lucky on this one, but this could have happened, because these are new observations and our random forest classification machine learning model didn't learn anything from this new observation point.
cues.zh: 這次運氣好，但的確可能發生，因為這是新觀測值，隨機森林分類機器學習模型沒有從這個新觀測點學過任何東西。

cues.en: So this guy could totally have ended up here.
cues.zh: 所以這個點完全可能落在這裡。

cues.en: So lucky on this one.
cues.zh: 這次很幸運。

cues.en: And by the way, same for this region here.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，這個區域也一樣。

cues.en: We don't have any red user, that is some user who didn't buy the SUV in this red region.
cues.zh: 這個紅色區域沒有任何紅色使用者，也就是沒有購買 SUV 的人。

cues.en: So this red region is totally not useful as well.
cues.zh: 所以這個紅色區域也完全沒有用。

cues.en: Okay, so that's the idea.
cues.zh: 好，概念就是這樣。

cues.en: But most of all, it did a pretty good job, because, of course, it caught most of the red users here with a low age and a low estimated salary, and, therefore, users who didn't buy the SUV
cues.zh: 不過整體表現仍相當好，因為涵蓋了大部分年齡低、預估薪資低的紅色使用者，也就是沒有購買 SUV 的人，

cues.en: and most of the green users who are quite older with a higher estimated salary who bought this awesome cheap luxury SUV.
cues.zh: 以及大部分年齡較高、預估薪資較高，購買了這款很棒、便宜又豪華 SUV 的綠色使用者。

cues.en: Okay, and now what is the conclusion of all this?
cues.zh: 好，這一切的結論是什麼？

cues.en: Because we reached the end of our classification adventure.
cues.zh: 因為分類冒險已經到了結尾。

cues.en: We built all our classifiers.
cues.zh: 所有分類器都建立好了。

cues.en: So according to you, what is the best classifier for this particular business problem?
cues.zh: 你認為，對這個特定商業問題，哪個分類器最好？

cues.en: What is the best one?
cues.zh: 最好的是哪個？

cues.en: It should be a classifier that classified correctly.
cues.zh: 應該是能正確分類

cues.en: The users who didn't buy the SUV and the users who bought the SUV and at the same time prevented overfitting in the training set to be able to make some good
cues.zh: 沒有購買 SUV 與有購買 SUV 的使用者，同時避免對訓練集過度擬合，能對新觀測值

cues.en: new predictions of some new observations.
cues.zh: 做出良好預測的分類器。

cues.en: So in my opinion, the best classifier would be the kernel SVM in terms of the balance between the percentage of incorrect predictions and the fact that we want to prevent overfitting.
cues.zh: 我認為，如果平衡錯誤預測比例與避免過度擬合，最好的分類器會是核心 SVM。

cues.en: Well, if we look at them again, in my opinion, the kernel SVM classifier would be the best one.
cues.zh: 再看一次，我認為核心 SVM 分類器最好。

cues.en: All right, so that's the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 好，這堂教學到此結束。

cues.en: And now I have to say congratulations, because you built a great deal of classifiers from simple classifiers with logistic regression
cues.zh: 現在必須恭喜你，因為你建立了大量分類器，從簡單的邏輯斯迴歸分類器，

cues.en: to more sophisticated and more complex classifiers like kernel SVM random forest classifiers.
cues.zh: 到更進階、複雜的核心 SVM 與隨機森林分類器。

cues.en: But that's not the end of the journey.
cues.zh: 但旅程還沒結束。

cues.en: In the next section, we will be talking about how to evaluate the performance of our models and how we can improve them.
cues.zh: 下一節會談如何評估模型效能，以及如何改善。

cues.en: And then, eventually, we will have a homework on a real-life data set where we will combine what we learned here about how to build some classifiers and all the next concepts that we will learn
cues.zh: 最後還會有真實資料集的作業，結合這裡學到的建立分類器知識，以及接下來要學的所有概念，

cues.en: to evaluate the model performance in order to find the best model for this real-life business problem data set that you will be given.
cues.zh: 來評估模型效能，為提供給你的真實商業問題資料集找出最佳模型。

cues.en: And we will do the job as a data scientist or a machine learning scientist would do in reality.
cues.zh: 我們會像真正的資料科學家或機器學習科學家一樣完成工作。

cues.en: So congratulations again.
cues.zh: 再次恭喜。

cues.en: I look forward to seeing you in the next section.
cues.zh: 期待下一節見到你。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
